title: The 4 Best Travel Adapters for Multiple Devices
h1: The 4 Best Travel Adapters for Multiple Devices
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for travel adapters for multiple devices, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel adapters for multiple devices using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter M8 Max
products.blurb: Key specs: 2 USA-standard outlets, 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port, Interchangeable plug attachments for 150+ countries.
strengths: Six total charging points, the most in this category at this price
18W USB-C PD is meaningfully faster than USB-A-only competitors for a phone
Grounded design covers laptop chargers that require a ground pin
limitations: 18W PD tops out well below what a laptop charger needs
features: 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port

products.name: BESTEK Universal Travel Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 AC sockets, 6A 4-port USB charging, 100-220V to 110V step-down conversion, 250W.
strengths: Seven total charging points across 3 AC sockets and 4 USB ports
Genuine voltage conversion covers single-voltage appliances too, not just plug shape
Handles a family's combined device load from one wall plug
limitations: Bulkiest unit in this list due to the internal conversion electronics
Audible fan noise reported during voltage conversion by some owners

products.name: EPICKA Universal Travel Adapter with USB-C
SublimeWare Power Plug Adapter with 4 USB Ports
strengths: Works with US, UK, EU and AU outlets
limitations: No USB-C on the base model
Shared USB output limits fast charging

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
